name: OVERNIGHT OATS WITH BANANA AND CHIA
steps: Stir the oats, milk, chia seeds and cinnamon together in a jar.
Cover and refrigerate overnight, or for at least 4 hours.
Stir once more and top with the sliced banana before eating.
chefsNote: Prepare two jars together for an easy second breakfast. The banana supplies enough sweetness without added sugar.

name: GREEK YOGURT FRUIT BOWL
steps: Spoon the yogurt into a bowl.
Top with papaya, almonds, chia seeds and cinnamon.
Serve immediately, or keep chilled until breakfast.
chefsNote: Swap papaya for guava, berries or mango while keeping the portion similar.

name: TUNA AND EGG WHOLEMEAL SANDWICH
steps: Mix the tuna, egg, mayonnaise and black pepper in a small bowl.
Layer cucumber and tomato over one slice of bread.
Add the tuna mixture, close the sandwich and cut in half.
chefsNote: Boil several eggs at once and keep them chilled for breakfasts and snacks during the week.

name: AYAM KUNYIT VEGETABLE RICE BOWL
ingredients: Chilli and black pepper to taste
steps: Coat the chicken with turmeric and black pepper.
Heat the oil in a wok and cook the chicken for 5 to 6 minutes.
Add garlic, chilli and vegetables; stir-fry until just tender.
Season with soy sauce and serve over the rice.
chefsNote: Use a large vegetable portion to keep the bowl generous without relying on extra oil.

name: AYAM PERCIK BROWN RICE BOWL
steps: Mix coconut milk, chilli-onion paste, tamarind, turmeric and salt.
Coat the chicken with half the sauce and grill or air-fry for 12 to 15 minutes.
Warm the remaining sauce in a small pan until bubbling.
Slice the chicken and serve with brown rice, ulam and the cooked sauce.
chefsNote: A thin percik glaze gives the flavour of the original without turning the sauce into the largest calorie source.

name: IKAN KEMBUNG WITH ULAM
steps: Rub the fish with turmeric and a small pinch of salt.
Grill or air-fry at 200°C for 12 to 15 minutes, turning once.
Serve with rice, ulam, sambal belacan and limau kasturi.
chefsNote: Kembung is an affordable oily fish and a useful alternative when salmon is not practical.

name: BIHUN SUP AYAM
ingredients: 1 cup bok choy and bean sprouts
steps: Bring the stock, ginger and garlic to a simmer for 5 minutes.
Add chicken and vegetables; cook for another 3 to 4 minutes.
Place the cooked bihun in a bowl and ladle the hot soup over it.
Finish with spring onion and white pepper.
chefsNote: Cooked chicken makes this a fast meal. Use homemade or reduced-sodium stock when possible.

name: NASI GORENG KAMPUNG RINGAN
ingredients: 1 clove garlic and 1 red chilli, minced
steps: Heat the oil in a wok and cook garlic, chilli and ikan bilis for 30 seconds.
Add chicken and stir-fry until cooked through.
Push the chicken aside, scramble the egg, then add rice and vegetables.
Season with soy sauce and toss over high heat until hot.
chefsNote: Keeping the oil measured and adding a full cup of vegetables makes this lighter without losing the wok-fried character.

name: TEMPEH SAMBAL BOWL
ingredients: 1 cup cucumber, tomato and salad greens
steps: Brush the tempeh with oil and air-fry at 190°C for 10 to 12 minutes.
Warm the sambal with soy sauce and a splash of water.
Toss the crisp tempeh through the sambal.
Serve over brown rice with the fresh vegetables and limau kasturi.
chefsNote: Air-frying keeps the tempeh crisp with much less oil than deep-frying.

name: TOFU GINGER-SOY BOWL
steps: Pat the tofu dry and brown it in sesame oil for 5 to 6 minutes.
Add ginger, garlic, mushrooms, capsicum and broccoli.
Stir-fry until the vegetables are tender-crisp, then add soy sauce and a splash of water.
Serve the tofu and vegetables over rice.
chefsNote: Pressing the tofu briefly under a plate helps it brown instead of steaming in the pan.

name: CHAPATI WITH DHAL
ingredients: ½ cup cucumber and tomato salad
steps: Warm the dhal in a saucepan, adding water if it is too thick.
Heat the chapati on a dry pan until soft and lightly browned.
Mix cucumber and tomato with yogurt, coriander and chilli.
Serve the chapati with dhal and the fresh salad.
chefsNote: This uses ready-made chapati and cooked dhal for speed. Choose dhal that is not finished with a heavy ghee tempering.

name: BLACK-PEPPER BEEF VEGETABLE BOWL
steps: Mix the beef with soy sauce, oyster sauce and black pepper.
Heat the oil in a wok and sear the beef for 2 to 3 minutes; remove to a plate.
Stir-fry garlic and vegetables until tender-crisp.
Return the beef, toss briefly and serve over rice.
chefsNote: Slice the beef across the grain so a lean cut stays tender during the fast stir-fry.
